name: Star Sapphire
source:
Main heroine enjoys her student life. One day she rescues a boy and gets drawn in a battle between white wings and black wings. Who is this boy and what's the reason of this struggle?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高月美咲原本享受着平静的校园生活。某天，她救下一名少年，却因此被卷入白翼与黑翼之间的争斗。这个少年究竟是谁？双方又为何而战？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
